children: Our Bureau Mumbai: Tata Group stocks plunged Friday, with Tata Chemicals heading the list of decliners, after Tata Trusts opposed the decision of the Tata Sons board to reappoint N Chandrasekaran as chairman and called the move illegal.
Tata Chemicals fell 11.5% to hit a low of 689.40 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), while Tata Consultancy Services, India's largest technology outsourcing company, declined nearly 4% to 2,104.90.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles fell 3.4%. Tata Investment Corp. retreated 2.5% to 700.95, while Tata Technologies fell 5.24% and Tata Elxsi slipped 1.5%.

These stocks had surged earlier this week on expectations that the central bank's rejection of a Tata Sons application to surrender its licence as a shadow lender would prompt the listing of Tata Sons, the holding company of India's most diversified conglomerate.

title: Tata Stocks Tumble as Trusts Opposes Chandra's 3rd Term
